Container.Name: binhex-gonic
Container.DonateText: If you appreciate my work, then please consider buying me a beer :D
Container.Overview: Free-software subsonic server API implementation, supporting its many clients.

Config.Name: Port: Web Interface
Config.Description: This is the port for the Web UI for the application

Config.Name: Path: /config
Config.Description: This is the container path to your configuration files, e.g. databases, configuration files, logs etc.

Config.Name: Path: /media
Config.Description: This is the container path to your media files, e.g. movies, tv, music, pictures etc.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_MUSIC_PATH
Config.Description: Path to your music collection inside the container. Multiple folders are supported as a comma separated list, e.g. '/media/music,/media/audiobooks'

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_PODCAST_PATH
Config.Description: Path to store downloaded podcasts. Keep this inside a mapped path such as /config so subscriptions survive container updates.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_PLAYLISTS_PATH
Config.Description: Path to store created playlists. Files use the 'userid/name.m3u' layout, e.g. '1/jazz.m3u' for the admin user, and are created and changed by gonic through the subsonic api. Keep this inside a mapped path such as /config.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_CACHE_PATH
Config.Description: Path to store audio transcodes, covers, etc. This path must exist inside the container, the application will not start if it is empty or missing.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_DB_PATH
Config.Description: Path to the gonic database file. Keep this inside a mapped path such as /config so your library database survives container updates.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_LISTEN_ADDR
Config.Description: Host and port to listen on, e.g. '0.0.0.0:4747' or '127.0.0.1:4747'. If not specified then the default of '0.0.0.0:4747' will be used. Change this only if you also change the container side of the Web Interface port.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_PROXY_PREFIX
Config.Description: Url path prefix to use if behind a reverse proxy, e.g. '/gonic'. If not specified then gonic will be served from the root path.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_TLS_CERT
Config.Description: Path to a TLS cert inside the container to enable HTTPS listening, e.g. '/config/gonic/certs/cert.pem'. Must be set together with the TLS key below. If not specified then gonic will serve plain HTTP, which is typical when a reverse proxy terminates TLS.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_TLS_KEY
Config.Description: Path to the TLS private key that matches the TLS cert above. Must be set together with the TLS cert.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_HTTP_LOG
Config.Description: Enable or disable HTTP request logging, enabled by default.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_SCAN_INTERVAL
Config.Description: Interval in minutes to automatically check for new music. Automatic scanning is disabled if this is not specified, a scan can still be started from the web interface.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_SCAN_AT_START_ENABLED
Config.Description: Whether to perform an initial scan of your music collection every time the container starts.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_SCAN_WATCHER_ENABLED
Config.Description: Whether to watch the file system for new music and rescan automatically. Use this or the scan interval above, there is usually no need to enable both.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_SCAN_EMBEDDED_COVER_ENABLED
Config.Description: Whether to scan for embedded covers in audio files, in addition to image files in the album folder. Enabled by default.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_EXCLUDE_PATTERN
Config.Description: Go regular expression matched against the absolute path of every file and folder whilst scanning, anything that matches is not imported. Example: '@eaDir|[aA]rtwork|[cC]overs|[sS]cans'. If the pattern is invalid then the application will not start.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_GENRE_TREE
Config.Description: Path to a tab separated genre hierarchy file inside the container, for hierarchical genre browsing. Each line contains a parent genre and a child genre separated by a tab character, e.g. 'electronic' followed by a tab followed by 'edm'. If the file is missing or invalid then the application will not start.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_MULTI_VALUE_GENRE
Config.Description: Setting for multi-valued genre tags when scanning, 'multi' uses the multi-valued tag fields written by tools such as MusicBrainz Picard or beets, 'delim <delimiter>' splits your single genre tag on a delimiter, e.g. 'delim ;', 'none' disables splitting (default). Note a comma delimiter must be escaped, e.g. 'delim \,', because the environment variable parser splits on comma.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_MULTI_VALUE_ARTIST
Config.Description: Setting for multi-valued artist tags when scanning, 'multi' uses the multi-valued tag fields, 'delim <delimiter>' splits your single artist tag on a delimiter, e.g. 'delim ;', 'none' disables splitting (default). Note a comma delimiter must be escaped, e.g. 'delim \,', because the environment variable parser splits on comma.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_MULTI_VALUE_ALBUM_ARTIST
Config.Description: Setting for multi-valued album artist tags when scanning, 'multi' uses the multi-valued tag fields, 'delim <delimiter>' splits your single album artist tag on a delimiter, e.g. 'delim ;', 'none' disables splitting (default). Using 'multi' or a delimiter keeps compilation appearances out of your artist list. Note a comma delimiter must be escaped, e.g. 'delim \,', because the environment variable parser splits on comma.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_MULTI_VALUE_ISRC
Config.Description: Setting for multi-valued isrc tags when scanning, 'multi' uses the multi-valued tag fields, 'delim <delimiter>' splits your single isrc tag on a delimiter, e.g. 'delim ;', 'none' disables splitting (default). Note a comma delimiter must be escaped, e.g. 'delim \,', because the environment variable parser splits on comma.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_TRANSCODE_CACHE_SIZE
Config.Description: Size of the transcode cache in MB, 0 or empty means no limit.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_TRANSCODE_EJECT_INTERVAL
Config.Description: Interval in minutes to eject the transcode cache, 0 or empty means never. Only used if a transcode cache size above 0 is set.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_COVER_CACHE_SIZE
Config.Description: Size of the cover art cache in MB, 0 or empty means no limit.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_COVER_EJECT_INTERVAL
Config.Description: Interval in minutes to eject the cover art cache, 0 or empty means never. Only used if a cover art cache size above 0 is set.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_PODCAST_PURGE_AGE
Config.Description: Age in days to purge podcast episodes if not accessed, 0 or empty means never purge.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_JUKEBOX_ENABLED
Config.Description: Whether the subsonic jukebox api should be enabled, for gapless server-side playback through the audio device of the host (mpv is included in this container). You may also need to pass the audio device of the host into the container.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_JUKEBOX_MPV_EXTRA_ARGS
Config.Description: Extra command line arguments to pass to the jukebox mpv daemon, e.g. '--audio-device=alsa/hdmi:CARD=HDMI'. Shell style quoting is supported.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_EXPVAR
Config.Description: Enable the /debug/vars endpoint, which exposes useful debugging attributes as well as database stats. Leave disabled unless troubleshooting.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_PPROF
Config.Description: Enable the /debug/pprof endpoint, used for profiling the application. Leave disabled unless troubleshooting.

Config.Name: Variable: GONIC_LOG_DB
Config.Description: Enable database query logging, this is very verbose. Leave disabled unless troubleshooting.

Config.Name: Variable: ENABLE_HEALTHCHECK
Config.Description: Enable or disable healthchecks.

Config.Name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_COMMAND
Config.Description: The command or script to execute, if not specified then the script healthcheck.sh will be used (process, dns and https checking).

Config.Name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_ACTION
Config.Description: The action to execute if the healthcheck command returns a non zero exit code, if not specified the action will be 'exit 1', if you want the container to exit on failure then set the action to 'kill 1'.

Config.Name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_HOSTNAME
Config.Description: The hostname used when performing HTTPS and DNS healthchecking.

Config.Name: Variable: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for the running container

Config.Name: Variable: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for the running container

Config.Name: Variable: UMASK
Config.Description: UMASK for the running container
